CILIATUM Webb & Berthelot, 1841 绯缘莲
"ciliatum"暗指"cilios",意为纤毛,根据其十分有区分度的外形,拟名为.

Photo John Richards
Synonym :
异名:
Sempervivum ciliatum Willdenow (1809)
Section Leuconium
琉康尼昂(音译)组
Distribution : Canary Islands (Nothern Tenerife); 200 - 1000 m.
分布:加那利群岛(特内里费岛北部);海拔200 - 1000m.
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
Perennial few-branched subshrubs to 1 m.
多年生少分枝亚灌木,高度可达1m左右.
Branches ascending, 5 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.
分枝上升,直径5 - 20mm,无毛,呈网状.
Rosette 8 - 20 cm in diameter, rather flattish.
莲座状叶,直径8 - 20cm,叶尖持平.
Leaves 4 - 12 x 2 - 5 cm, 4 – 8 mm thick, obovate-spatulate, apically acute, basally attenuate or cuneate, glaucous, glabrate, dark green to yellowish-green, occasionally slightly folded longitudinally near the apex, margin with straight or slightly curved cilia 0.4 - 0.8 mm.
叶片长4 - 12cm,宽2 - 5cm,厚4- 8mm,倒卵状匙形,先端尖锐,基部变细或呈楔形,叶被白霜,光滑,深绿色至黄绿色,偶尔会在叶尖附近出现纵向的0.4 - 0.8mm的纤毛.
Inflorescences domeshaped, 15 - 40 x 10 - 35 cm, peduncle 5 - 20 cm, pedicels 2 - 4 mm, puberulent.
穹顶状花序,高15 - 40cm,宽10 - 35cm,总花梗5 - 20cm,花梗长2 - 4cm,被微柔毛.
Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 7 - 10 x 1.2 - 2 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, lower face often greenish variegated, filaments sparsely puberulent.
花基数7 - 9,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长7 - 10mm,宽1.2 - 2mm,披针形,渐尖,发白,花瓣背面通常呈绿色杂色,花丝有稀疏的微柔毛.
Cytology : n=18
染色体:n=18
Easily confused with A. davidbramwellii.
与A.davidbramwellii容易混淆.

进入夏季的Aeonium ciliatum.
©carlesjbox理想状态,或者说特征显现时的Aeonium ciliatum:

Photo Ray StephensonAeonium ciliatum绯缘莲是一个非常有特点的,能与Echeveria的红缘媲美的Aeonium,不过有时候,经常与Aeonium haworthii(夕映)及其优选种Aeonium 'Kiwi'混淆.它一定会是一个很棒的亲本.
